overall.summary: Of the six flags raised, only one represents a genuine disclosure degradation concern: the removal of detailed income tax provision data from the Q2 10-Q MD&A compared to Q1. One borderline flag relates to the absence of tariff impact discussion, which warrants monitoring but may reflect ACLS's legitimately different margin trajectory. The remaining four flags are dismissed due to incorrect flag orientation (ACLS was actually the better discloser), irrelevant peer comparisons reflecting genuine business differences, or mismatched disclosure sections.
